_comment: Gatekeeper budgets and retry policy. User has enterprise license so caps are generous; these are sanity ceilings not budget squeezes.
_web_search_provider_doc: One of: anthropic_builtin | tavily | exa | omnisearch. Only switch if Anthropic web_search is disabled at the org level.
_pricing_doc: Anthropic per-1M-token list prices, consumed by the gatekeeper for cost accounting. Update when Anthropic changes its pricing card; the gatekeeper has no fallback for unknown models (cost simply isn't counted).
